app.name: SnailNet
link.not_running.title: SnailNet isn't running
link.not_running.body: Your internet works normally, but nothing is being shared out. SnailNet connects by itself as soon as its service starts.
link.rejected.title: This copy of SnailNet can't control the service
link.rejected.body: Only the SnailNet app installed in the same folder as the service may change it. Open SnailNet from the Start menu instead.
link.denied.title: Windows didn't let SnailNet reach its service
link.denied.body: Signing out and back in usually fixes this. Details: {detail}
link.lost.title: Lost contact with SnailNet
link.lost.body: Reconnecting… Your internet keeps working meanwhile.
state.unshaped.title: Watching only
state.unshaped.body: Tell SnailNet how fast your connection is, and it starts sharing it out by your rules.
state.retrying.title: Traffic control stepped aside
state.retrying.body: Your internet works normally. SnailNet tries again in a moment. ({reason})
state.safe_mode.title: Safe mode
state.safe_mode.body: Traffic control stopped after {failures} problems in a row, so your internet runs as if SnailNet weren't here. Restart the SnailNet service to try again.
split.label: How your connection is shared
split.empty: No slices yet, so every app shares the connection fairly.
split.conflict: The rules changed somewhere else just now. The bar shows the new version; try again.
list.empty.title: No traffic yet
list.empty.body: Apps show up here as soon as they use the internet.
